staffPreheader: Isikhumbuzo esivela ku-{company} mayelana namadokhumenti akho.
staffIntro: I-{company} ilandelela amadokhumenti akho nge-Vaultara. Lawa adinga ukunakwa maduze:
staffAction: Sicela uvuselele ngesikhathi bese unika i-{company} ikhophi yedokhumenti entsha.
staffContact: Imibuzo? Phendula le-imeyili ukuze uxhumane ne-{company}.
staffFooterWhy: Uthola le-imeyili ngoba i-{company} yengeze ikheli lakho le-imeyili ukuze kuthunyelwe izikhumbuzo zamadokhumenti.
staffConfirmBody: Ngeke usathola ama-imeyili ezikhumbuzo zamadokhumenti avela ku-{company}.
staffUnsubscribedBody: Ngeke usathola izikhumbuzo zamadokhumenti ezivela ku-{company}. Xhumana nabo uma ushintsha umqondo.
invalidLinkBody: Isixhumanisi kungenzeka sidala noma asiphelele. Xhumana nebhizinisi elisithumele.
reportPreheader: Ubani osesimweni, okuphelelwa ezinsukwini ezingu-30 ezizayo, nokuphelelwe yisikhathi.
reportIntro: Nansi indlela amadokhumenti ethimba lakho ame ngayo namuhla. Uhlu oluphelele luhlanganisiwe njengefayela lesiprediyishithi (CSV).
reportNothing: Awekho amarekhodi okubika okwamanje. Engeza ithimba lakho namadokhumenti alo ku-Vaultara.
reportFooterWhy: Uthola le-imeyili ngoba usebenzisa uhlelo lwe-Business lwe-Vaultara. Ungalucima ku-Vaultara esikrinini Somndeni.
reportConfirmTitle: Yeka umbiko wenyanga nenyanga wokuthobela imithetho?
reportConfirmBody: Ngeke usathola umbiko wokuthobela imithetho nge-imeyili.
reportUnsubscribedBody: Ngeke usathola umbiko wokuthobela imithetho. Ungawuvula futhi ku-Vaultara esikrinini Somndeni.
requestPreheader: I-{company} icela usuku olusha lokuphelelwa nesithombe sedokhumenti yakho evuselelwe.
requestIntro: I-{company} ikucela ukuthi uthumele usuku olusha lokuphelelwa nesithombe noma i-PDF yale dokhumenti evuselelwe:
requestValidity: Lesi sixhumanisi sisebenza izinsuku ezi-7 futhi sisetshenziswa kanye kuphela.
requestFooterWhy: Uthola le-imeyili ngoba i-{company} icele ukubuyekezwa kwedokhumenti ebilandelela ngenxa yakho. Uma ubungayilindele, ungayinaka le-imeyili.
